The edges of the wooden frame show slight softness and blending with the wall shadow, lacking the crisp hard-edge definition expected of solid wood against a painted wall.
The connection point between the lower circular dial and the central wooden stem appears slightly fused or ill-defined, lacking a clear mechanical mounting bracket or screw detail.
